_what_this_is: THE STACK-SPECIFIC HALF OF THE HARNESS, for auteur.
Commands reused from .github/workflows/validation.yml (per the harness rule:
whatever CI runs is a tested answer - do not invent a second definition).
The E2E drives the real CLI offline: story-discovery start -> refine ->
review -> compose -> accept, with canonical story_identity.yaml asserted
absent at every step before acceptance. The LLM-dependent `run` subcommand
is deliberately outside the unattended gate (cost, keys, nondeterminism);
the deterministic compose path is the journey the harness proves.
_driver: cli - the whole product surface is the auteur command.

cli._note: invoke is python -m auteur.cli (main guard at cli.py). The venv's editable install resolves auteur from THIS worktree's src/.
